zh.summary: 0.6.1 改进流式任务期间的桌面响应、托盘资源释放、启动等待与诊断，并包含此前积累的插件修复。
highlights: 合并密集会话事件，相同状态不再反复刷新原生托盘；菜单重建释放旧资源，减少长时间运行的重复开销。
启动期间减少 Windows 进程查询，保留就绪前的身份核验；启动与支持报告只读取所需日志尾部。
修正维护命令的 capsule 运行时入口，避免把已提取的运行时误报为缺少安装文件。
已有配置目录缺少插件清单时不再因默认插件刷新中断启动或升级检查，并保留该目录中的用户文件。
修正 Windows 长短路径双向进程识别，避免切换路径写法后重复启动后台、遗留进程和占用便携目录。
随附 pnpm 升级至 11.11.0，并改进插件更新目标锁定、待重启状态、原生模块卸载提示、截图刷新和 WebDAV 下载重定向。
knownIssues: Issue #89 的用户环境曾在 DSH 导入阶段发生 60 秒超时；本次修复减少已确认的桌面与启动开销，但尚未证明该环境的超时和全部卡顿均已消除。
此描述为待发布候选，跨平台成品验收和正式发布尚未完成。
upgradeNotes: 安装更新前结束运行中的任务并备份数据。保持产品发布与上游内核发布独立。

en.summary: 0.6.1 improves desktop responsiveness during streaming, tray resource disposal, startup polling and diagnostics, and includes accumulated plugin fixes.
highlights: Coalesce session bursts and skip unchanged native tray projections. Dispose retired menu resources to reduce repeated work during long sessions.
Reduce Windows process inspection during startup while retaining identity verification before readiness. Read only the required log tails during startup and support export.
Route maintenance commands through the capsule runtime entry to avoid reporting extracted runtime files as missing from the installation.
An existing profile without a plugin manifest no longer interrupts startup or upgrade preflight during default-plugin refresh; existing files are preserved.
Recognize Windows short and long paths in both directions to prevent duplicate backends and orphaned processes holding the portable directory.
Bundle pnpm 11.11.0 and improve plugin update targeting, restart state, native-addon removal guidance, screenshot refresh and WebDAV download redirects.
knownIssues: Issue #89 includes a 60-second timeout during DSH import. These changes reduce confirmed desktop and startup overhead; resolution of that environment's timeout and all reported lag remains unverified.
This is a pending release candidate description. Cross-platform product qualification and publication are not complete.
upgradeNotes: Finish active tasks and back up data before updating. Portable publishing remains independent of upstream engine releases.
